info.title: NYALES WEB-068 workload and territory scenario API
info.description: Explicit monthly service policy, server-derived entire scoped portfolios and immutable scenario revisions. No travel/routing or optimization. No business defaults or invisible assignments. R2 stores private evidence; D1 stores versioned references. Local implementation; not production acceptance.

x-cross-field-rules: Weights explicitly total 10000 basis points. Blank demand/capacity stays null. At most one known capacity per person across current/historical channels.

A customer belongs to one batch; both channels must be reviewed together for a customer area transfer. Assignment cohorts must use explicit customer_ids. Batch and basis effective dates match; no past business dates.
Preview derives source once and verifies geometry once across bounded batches. Final epoch recheck prevents mixed input.
Save validates the exact preview hash, epoch and active policy again. Revisions append; If-Match binds scenario root version.
Application uses one immutable latest current revision and one atomic WEB-065 batch. Changes epoch; remaining batches require a new preview and revision. Applied batch keys cannot be reused.
Snapshot checksums, tenant, scope, dates and reference identity are verified before reads/applications. Source rights/coverage and complete positive baselines remain required.
Historical invoice, target, activity and incentive attribution remains unchanged. Monthly calendar capacity is planned service allocation; individual absence and travel remain outside this feature.
